intro h
split
· intro s a ha
  have : s ⊆ Finset.cons a s ha := Finset.cons_subset _ _ ha
  exact h s (Finset.cons a s ha) (Finset.subset_trans this (Finset.cons_subset_right _ _))
· intros s t hst
  obtain ⟨s', hss', ht⟩ := Finset.exists_chain_from_subset hst
  induction s' using Finset.induction_on with s' a hsa hs'
  case Finset.empty => 
    exact le_refl (f s')
  case cons a s' hsa hs' =>
    have : f s' ≤ f (Finset.cons a s' hsa) := h s' a hsa
    exact le_trans (hs' _) this
